## Rust-Only Enforcement

This repository is **Rust-only** for implementation and operational workflows.

- New build, bench, gate, orchestration, and production workflow logic must be implemented in Rust.
- Do not add new shell-script (`.sh`) or Python (`.py`) workflow drivers for core repo operations.
- Do not add new Makefile wrappers for Rust operations; run Cargo entrypoints directly.
- Place new operational entrypoints as Rust binaries in `crates/gororoba_cli/src/bin/` and register them in `crates/gororoba_cli/Cargo.toml`.
- Any non-Rust exception requires explicit user approval and must be documented as a temporary legacy exception in `agents.toml`.
